response.justification: A highly experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong track record in testing culture, developer tooling, and even IDE work (C/C++ components for NI LabWindows/CVI), plus relevant open-source tooling (test runner, assertion library). However, the core requirements of this role — deep Java/Kotlin/JVM expertise and solid Spring/enterprise-framework experience — are essentially absent: Java appears only briefly (robotic arms, device orchestration circa 2016-2018) and Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, and Hibernate are not mentioned at all. Recent work is TypeScript/Node and AI-agent tooling. Worth a conversation only if the team is open to a strong generalist who would need significant ramp-up on the JVM enterprise stack; otherwise there are likely better-matched candidates.
strengths: Prior IDE-internals experience building C/C++ components for LabWindows/CVI
Deep developer-tooling and testing background (own test runner, assertion library, CI/CD, TDD advocacy)
Broad, long-tenured senior/staff experience across low-latency, distributed, and full-stack systems
concerns: No demonstrated Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate experience
No Kotlin experience and only minimal, dated Java exposure
Recent focus is TypeScript/Node, not JVM or large-scale desktop tooling
